minor.issue: 'purchased' counts ALL purchase grants regardless of status: abandoned/superseded checkouts (status 'expired', set at addons.py L283 when a new checkout starts) are counted. Reproduced: bronze org, 3 unpaid checkouts -> purchased=2 although nothing was paid. Same for 'granted': revoked omaggi/promo still counted (SA dialog shows 'omaggi/promo 1' after revoke). Fix: filter by status in ('active') (or active+expired-by-date only) in the sums at L132-133.
Grammar when limit == 1: 'include fino a 1 persone Staff e Volontari' (only reachable via org exception max_users=1). Cosmetic.
event_ids beyond events_total are silently ignored (no error/feedback); events already covered are silently skipped. Consider returning skipped ids.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /eventi/{uncovered}/planner shows the same info toast twice (two requests/effects each fire toast.info). Use a toast id or guard.
Link is /marketplace?servizio=event-planner without the event id, so AddonBuy event select (addon-buy-event) is not preselected with the event the user clicked; user must pick it again.
